market_name: Will 3 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the direction of the Polymarket probability move (rising = dovish) and check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields and Fed funds futures are moving consistently.
time_plan.1h: Check for any macro catalyst (CPI, jobs, Fedspeak) that already explains the repricing; if public data drove it, downgrade signal value.
time_plan.2h: Reassess TLT vs. the implied-probability move; look for divergence suggesting noise rather than genuine rate repricing.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether the move persisted or mean-reverted; check overnight fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Close research window: compare realized TLT return to expectation and note whether the market anticipated any public news.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 3 Fed cuts in 2026 signals a more dovish rate path. Lower expected policy rates pull down the yield curve, especially the long end via lower forward-rate and term-premium expectations, lifting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the most direct, liquid proxy for that duration exposure. The reverse holds if the market repriced toward fewer cuts (hawkish).

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify probability direction and check DXY / EURUSD are moving in line (dovish = weaker USD).
time_plan.1h: Screen for competing drivers — foreign central-bank news or risk-off flows that can override the rate-differential channel.
time_plan.2h: Check whether the dollar move tracks the Treasury move; inconsistency implies weak signal.
time_plan.6h: Reassess persistence and whether any scheduled data explained the shift.
time_plan.12h: Close window: compare realized UUP move to expectation and log calibration.

predictions.reasoning: A dovish shift toward more 2026 cuts narrows US rate differentials versus other G10 currencies, which typically weakens the dollar. UUP tracks the DXY basket and is the standard liquid proxy. Effect is smaller and noisier than the Treasury channel because FX also depends on relative central-bank paths abroad.

evidence_used: Market resolves on the count of 25bp FOMC cuts in 2026, a direct read on the expected Fed policy path
Standard macro transmission: dovish rate expectations lower Treasury yields, weaken USD, and support gold
TLT and UUP are highly liquid proxies for duration and dollar exposure
uncertainty_notes: Direction of the asset move depends entirely on which way the implied probability shifted; a hawkish repricing flips all signs
12h magnitudes for these macro proxies are far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so none of these are actionable trades
Fed-path expectations are frequently driven by public data (CPI, NFP, Fedspeak), meaning the prediction market likely lags rather than leads
The 'military_conflict' topic tag appears mislabeled; this is a monetary-policy market

llm_justification.summary: This market is a direct gauge of expected 2026 Fed easing. A sharp increase in the probability of 3 cuts implies a more dovish policy path, which should lift long-duration Treasuries (TLT) and modestly weaken the US dollar (UUP); a hawkish repricing would reverse both. Both mappings are macro-standard but low-magnitude over a 12h window and well below the tradable threshold, and Fed expectations are usually set by public data rather than leaked information.
key_assumptions: The implied-probability move is a sharp dovish increase (predictions invert if hawkish)
Rate-differential and duration channels operate normally with no dominant offsetting shock
No large risk-off event overrides the rate-path signal
failure_modes: The probability move was driven by already-public macro data (CPI/NFP/Fedspeak), so no information leakage — the market lags rather than leads
Direction assumed dovish may be wrong; a hawkish repricing reverses both trades
12h moves are small and dominated by noise; proxies barely respond to marginal 2026-path repricing
FX proxy is weakly exposed because foreign central-bank paths can dominate USD direction
Prediction-market liquidity may be thin, making the probability move itself unreliable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
